howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以管理 Godot 项目（打开编辑器、运行项目、获取调试输出），创建和编辑场景（添加节点、保存场景），分析脚本和场景中的问题，搜索官方文档，以及运行测试。
howto.when: 当你在做 Godot 游戏开发，并且安装了 Godot 4 时，Claude 会使用这些工具来帮助你。

say.text: 帮我创建一个新场景，根节点为 Node2D。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can manage Godot projects (open editor, run project, get debug output), create and edit scenes (add nodes, save scenes), analyze scripts and scenes for issues, search official documentation, and run tests.
howto.when_en: When you are doing Godot game development and have Godot 4 installed, Claude will use these tools to assist you.

say_en.text: Create a new scene with a Node2D root node.
say_en.note: Claude will call the create_scene tool.

say_en.text: Run my Godot project and capture debug output.
say_en.note: Claude will call run_project and get_debug_output.

say_en.text: Analyze this GDScript file for common pitfalls.
